process.heading: How We Work
process.lead: A deliberate sequence. Every step ends with something you can review, not a status update.

steps.title: Discover
steps.text: Workshops, stakeholder interviews and an audit of what already exists.

steps.title: Define
steps.text: Scope, architecture and success metrics agreed before estimating.

steps.title: Design
steps.text: Flows, systems and interface prototypes you can click through.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Short iterations, reviewable increments, automated tests and CI.

steps.title: Launch
steps.text: Hardening, load and security checks, then a monitored release.

steps.title: Improve
steps.text: Telemetry, iteration and a roadmap that answers to real usage.

why.heading: Why teams choose us
why.lead: The difference is rarely the framework. It is how the work is decided, built and handed over.
